notes: מָעוֹל מַעַל: the infinitive absolute carries the verb 'trespassed' and the cognate noun the intensifier 'sore'; assigning 'sore' to the infinitive absolute under rule 56 was the competing reading, but here the finite slot is filled by the infinitive absolute itself.
בַּעֲבוּר fuses as one rendering 'because of' under rule 30, source head on עֲבוּר and target head on 'because'.
